about.title: About Me
about.description: Android Engineer with 5+ years of experience, currently focused on performance, observability and architecture for the Itaú Unibanco app — used by tens of millions of people every day. To me, good code isn't just code that works: it's code you can measure, understand and continuously improve.

journey.title: My Journey
journey.description1: I started in back-end (PHP/Laravel) in 2020 and moved to Android at Itaú Unibanco in 2021, as a Junior IT Engineering Analyst. Today, as a Mid-level Analyst, I'm still on the same team — but now focused on performance, observability and multi-module architecture for the bank's app.
journey.description2: Day to day, that means monitoring crash rate, ANRs and latency (p95/p99) for critical flows in production, and turning that data into concrete technical decisions. I've given an internal talk on Android memory management for Itaú's engineering team, and I'm an AWS Certified Cloud Practitioner.

projects.title: My Projects
projects.description: Below are some projects that highlight my work as an Android developer, showcasing my technical skills, creativity and focus on usability and performance.

items.title: Paguei!
items.description: Android app to centralize and organize expenses and bills, with an intuitive interface and support for splitting costs.

items.title: Personal Portfolio

items.title: PhotoBoost
items.description: Node.js script for bulk image processing from templates defined by designers, speeding up the creation of visual content.

items.title: Revise
items.description: Web app for preventive vehicle maintenance. Lets the user register their car's mileage and, based on that, recommends services and parts to check periodically.
